dataset.rights_note: The dataset repository declares MIT, but its README identifies Football-Data.co.uk as the underlying match-results source. The upstream provider states its free data is for private personal/academic use and not commercial AI/model training. Treat this backtest as research-only until a commercial data licence or clean licensed dataset is used.

recent_holdout.method: latest 20% of unique live-eligible forecast dates

same_match_goal_market_comparison.delta_convention: Dixon-Coles minus live recent-goals Poisson; negative Brier/log loss is better

poisson.note: predicted_share is the frequency with which a class is the single argmax, not the mean probability assigned to that outcome. Mean predicted probability and its gap from observed frequency are reported separately.

dixon_coles.note: predicted_share is the frequency with which a class is the single argmax, not the mean probability assigned to that outcome. Mean predicted probability and its gap from observed frequency are reported separately.

elo.note: predicted_share is the frequency with which a class is the single argmax, not the mean probability assigned to that outcome. Mean predicted probability and its gap from observed frequency are reported separately.

poisson.note: Thresholds are diagnostic only. A high accuracy at tiny coverage is not general model accuracy; no forecasts are suppressed by this audit.

poisson.important_note: This measures performance on market-defined favourites and underdogs; it does not directly measure club fame or prove causal popularity bias. Use chronological out-of-sample forecasts and de-vigged pre-match odds.
